sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:180380
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 38283 of 2023

Applicant :- Pawan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Sujan Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Sri Jhamman Ram, learned AGA-I, for the State, apprised the Court that on 14.8.2023 notice has been served to the informant of the case.
2. Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.

3. Heard Sri Sujan Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jhamman Ram, learned AGA-I,
for the State.
4. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in added Sections in relation to Case Crime No.09 of 2023, under Section 5J(ii)/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Shahganj, Agra, District Agra during pendency of the trial.
5.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that on 7.7.2023 applicant was released on bail by Coordinate Bench of this Court in the present matter relating to Case Crime No.09 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366 and 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Shahganj, Agra, District Pawan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5932845/
1 Agra but during investigation Section 5j(ii)/6 POCSO Act have been replaced from Section 3/4 POCSO Act.
6.

entities.text: District Pawan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that after submission of charge sheet when applicant applied for bail under Section 5j(ii)/6 POCSO Act then his bail application was dismissed by court concerned.

7. He further submits that as this Court after considering the entire facts of the case in detail granted bail to applicant under Sections 363, 366 and 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, therefore,
applicant should also be released on bail under Section 5j(ii)/6 POCSO Act.
8. He further submits that bail granting order dated 7.7.2023 passed by this Court has been annexed as Annexure-1 to the affidavit filed in support of the instant bail application.
9. Per contra, learned AGA although opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. Considering the fact that on 7.7.2023 this Court granted bail to the applicant in the present case,
i.e., in Case Crime No.09 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366 and 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act,
Police Station Shahganj, Agra, District Agra with a detailed and reasoned order, therefore, in my view, applicant is also entitled to be released on bail in Section 5j(ii)/6 POCSO Act.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant-Pawan be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the Pawan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5932845/
2 merits of the case during trial.
